occupations.title: Project Management Specialists
occupations.rationale: ClickUp is explicitly described as the "industry's best project management solution" used to "Deliver projects on time, every time" with features like tasks, sprints, goals, and milestones [D:ClickUp:landing:9, D:ClickUp:features:7].

occupations.title: Software Developers
occupations.rationale: The platform supports agile software development by offering features to manage "Sprints," "sprint points," and custom task types like "Bugs," and it integrates with developer tools such as GitHub [D:ClickUp:features:7, D:ClickUp:features:9, D:ClickUp:features:12, D:ClickUp:landing:4].

occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.rationale: The excerpts show the product is used to track key marketing metrics such as "Growth & Acquisition" and "Paid Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)," which are core responsibilities for marketing managers [D:ClickUp:landing:7].
